about_the_game:
Murder at Miller Farm!

Two months ago, a horrifying tragedy struck the quiet town of Coffeyville, Kansas. On the outskirts of town, in an old farmhouse, Margaret Miller—believed to be suffering from psychological issues—brutally murdered her husband, Edward Miller, with an axe, and then took her own life by hanging herself.

After that blood-chilling night, the family's young daughter, Lily, vanished without a trace. Only 11 years old, Lily left behind no sign, no clue. Despite search efforts by the police, no evidence regarding her whereabouts could be found.

Michael Wolf, a young journalist working for the town's local newspaper, had heard the strange rumors spreading through the community. There were chilling reports of a girl resembling Lily wandering around the farmhouse at night. Driven by curiosity, he set off toward the abandoned farmhouse to investigate the truth behind the whispers.

Is Lily Dead or Alive?

What happened to Lily? Was she dead, murdered or kidnapped?

Traces of The Past!

The diary entries Lily left behind are eerie and deeply disturbing! Are they a cry for help or demonic vengeance?

Strange Sounds!

Whispers, screams and spooky strange sounds. I wonder what they mean.

Unexpected Truth?

Could what's happening on this farm be real? Or is everything an illusion?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 14393.102 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i5-2550K, 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970 / AMD RX 480 8GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 14393.102 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770, 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 or GeForce GTX 1060 | Radeon R9 290X or Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: What Happened to Lily? is a Real-Time First Person Horror Game. We Investigate The Mystery Behind The Tragic Event That Happened in a Farmhouse 2 Months Ago.
